final: WITH c AS (SELECT p.product_color AS color, AVG(i.derived_product_cost) AS ca FROM Products p JOIN Invoice_Line_Items i ON i.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), o AS (SELECT AVG(ca) AS oa FROM c), k AS (SELECT c.color, c.ca, c.ca - o.oa AS excess FROM c JOIN o WHERE c.ca > o.oa), a AS (SELECT AVG(ca) AS ka FROM k) SELECT k.color, k.ca, k.excess, k.ca - a.ka AS diff_from_kept_avg FROM k JOIN a ON 1=1 WHERE k.ca > a.ka
